title: fksw — Frikanalen network
description: fksw laid out by what is plugged into it: WAN uplink, LACP bundles by host, the D9036 transport stream, and management ports. Encodes port numbers from fksw's configuration -- recabling the switch means editing this. The generic per-metric view is the 'Juniper switch (junos_exporter)' dashboard.

panels.title: VC members present
panels.description: Both members of the preprovisioned virtual chassis should be present.

panels.title: WAN uplink — ge-0/0/47
panels.description: ge-0/0/47, the only access port in vlan wan. Receive and transmit share a panel because they share a unit -- this is not a second axis.\n\nThe WAN vlan is also trunked to tx3 (ge-0/0/7), vmtx1 (ae15 and xe-0/1/2) and every LACP bundle. junos_exporter reports per-port counters, not per-vlan ones, so traffic on those trunks cannot be split into WAN and internal here.

panels.title: file01
panels.description: file01: member links distributing, out of the two ae1 is configured with (ge-0/0/9, ge-1/0/9). 1/2 means the bundle is up but at half bandwidth, which nothing else notices.

panels.title: Bundle member links
panels.description: Member port labels come from fksw's interface descriptions, baked in here rather than joined at query time.

panels.title: vmtx1 10G — xe-0/1/2
panels.description: vmtx1's 10G trunk, deliberately outside ae15 -- link-speed on an aggregate is uniform, so a 10G port cannot join a 1G bundle.

panels.title: Optical receive power
panels.description: The three xe- ports are the only ones with transceivers. A slow slide here is an optic going, usually weeks before the link drops.

panels.title: ge-0/0/33 — Secondary D9036 TS port 1
panels.description: The only port on fksw carrying actual video: the secondary D9036's transport stream out. This going quiet is the one that matters.

panels.title: TS port errors and drops
panels.description: Errors on a transport stream port surface as picture artefacts long before they surface as an outage.

panels.title: Management link state
panels.description: BMC/IPMI and appliance management ports. All of these are in vlan internal (id 3) despite the naming -- vlan management (id 4, 192.168.4.2) has an IRB address but no member ports at all.

panels.title: All described ports
panels.description: Everything on fksw carrying a description, straight from the switch. Ports that are configured but undescribed do not appear.
